_about: Five bot groups for the TEST galaxy, named after the first five Aurebesh letters. Each group's leader carries the group's name, so reports and in-game sightings say who did what. Edit focus/members freely; account names must stay unique and be listed in AgentAccounts (squad.py accounts).

Aurek.focus: World-boss crew: two fighters (boss gear, trained to certify it) with a support camp nearby: Tamsin trained to Doctor (enhancement buffs, healing), Sela the entertainer (dance/music buffs), Oren the scout trained to Ranger (camps). Also: hunting, incapacitation, death and cloning, combat XP. Bosses come from Rhea Tannor's trail list.

Besh.focus: Gatherers with a guard: survey and sample every resource type their tools allow, forage, harvest meat/hide/bone from the guard's kills, train gathering skills at trainers, keep resource containers through a relog; crafting and trade once the body supports them. Varo guards: he clears creatures near the gatherers before they kneel to sample.

Cresh.focus: Travel and missions: travel terminals and tickets, shuttles and starports, other planets and cities, mission terminals, the world-boss hunter (Rhea Tannor) and boss trails.

Dorn.focus: Social and group: group invite/join/leave, /leash follow assist, chat and tells, emotes, entertainer dance/music and buffs in the cantina, the mercenary broker (Dax Venn), NPC conversations.

Esk.focus: Navigation and buildings: /agentpath routes outdoors and indoors, multi-cell buildings, doorways, long routes, terrain height, stuck spots; three bots moving at once as a light load test. Also the Hoth crew (owner, 14 Oct: 'give esk a crew similar to the world boss crew'): Esk and Tovan trained and geared like Aurek's fighters (boss kit), Lira trained to Doctor for healing.

Forn.focus: Dungeon crew (owner, 15 Oct: 'give me a crew and we can test their combat more and their movement and mapping'): five full 250-point pre-CU templates (Documentation-support/dungeon-builds.md). Forn leads as Squad Leader/Rifleman; Brask tanks as Fencer/Pikeman/Medic; Ressa is Teras Kasi/Fencer/Medic; Dask is Commando/Rifleman; Mirren heals as Doctor/Combat Medic. Combat drills, travel and mapping on other planets, then the dungeons: Warren, Geonosian lab, Death Watch bunker, Corellian corvette.
